title: One of the most reliable Apple analysts has reportedly left for a new job - and it's bad news for Apple fans (AAPL)
text: One of the most reliable Apple analysts has reportedly left for a new job — and it's bad news for Apple fans (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Apr 30, 2018, 1:00 pm 11 pts Analyst Ming-Chi Kuo has become famous among Apple observers for publishing accurate rumors about upcoming Apple products. Now he's left his bank, KGI Securities, according to a Chinese-language report. If you've heard a rumor about an unreleased Apple product in the past five years, there's a…
